name: Oki Kotori
source:
Fetish: Sadism (especially insulting), masochism
Weak spot: Being trained

A frivolous girl, the school's problem child who aims to become a detective. [url=/c63053]Sister Natsume's[/url] little sister, however because of their stark differences they don't look and feel like sisters at all. She's rumored to pick both fights and men on the city, and because of that, the ojousamas in her class are afraid of her and avoid her.

Kotori has the courage to point when someone is doing something wrong, and that makes the [url=/c63055]protagonist[/url] to start to admire her. She also hates the fact that she was born into a religious family, basically a family who follows blindly what the bible and other people say, especially her sister.

Kotori loves insulting and pointing out people's flaws. She gives a cold impression at first, but after she's warmed enough to you, you can see she has a surprisingly obedient side to orders and training. After falling in love, she will become completely submissive to you, but still a sadist to others. Confess and show your love for her during sex and she will just melt!

[spoiler]She's been chosen to be the first girl to be "sold", and is considered a kind of "Holy Mother" by the school sisters, one that will guide the other girls to the same path, and she hates this because she will marry without love. That's why she became a delinquent in order try to avoid the marriage, without success.. Because of that,[/spoiler] Recently she's thinking about what is love, and ended up thinking that she doesn't have love inside her. Show her she's wrong.
